Air India Flight Makes Emergency Landing in Jaipur After Bomb Threat

An Air India flight traveling from Frankfurt to Delhi received a bomb threat, prompting an emergency landing in Jaipur. The pilot activated the 'hijack code' before landing. Airport authorities were alerted, causing a stir at the Jaipur airport.
